2026-10-23.summary:
### Building & Construction
- Fixed roof overhang collider behavior and added proper ColliderInfo to overhangs and frames, preventing incorrect collisions when building.
- Corrected the toast notification shown when rotating boat building blocks.
- Buildings no longer split when blocks are flipped; rotation and flip checks now account for final orientation, fixing mirrored stairs issues and the 10‑minute flip window reset bug.
- Demolish option now correctly requires building privilege and shows an informative toast when disabled.
- Enabled the Scrap King building skin in standalone mode.

### Tools & Item Balance
- Shears now yield 25% more wool, have 200% knife durability, and deal 50% less damage.

### World & Creatures
- Plants grown on boats remain visible while sailing by using dynamic renderers.
- Animals no longer automatically turn toward the player when petted, preventing them from getting stuck.

### Player Items & Skins
- First‑join bug fixed: spawned rocks and torches now use the selected skin instead of the default.

### Delivery Pod Vehicle
- DPV radial menu now shows Mount, Fuel, and Pickup; condition persists after pickup; acceleration speed doubled; fuel consumption reduced from 0.15 → 0.08 /s and idle fuel usage lowered.

items.text: Merged rotate and flip actions into a single pie‑menu slot, toggled with E/Q, preserving muscle memory and adjusting building tiers.
Added mirrored stair skin prefabs and a bake tool, expanding the variety of usable building skins.
Fixed a bug where the spray can became unusable after quickly looking away, requiring re‑equip, and removed a duplicate third‑person spray animation.
Corrected the server collider for sails so only the appropriate (raised or lowered) collider is active after spawning.
Fixed the quit button so it now works correctly.
Disabled the deployable corpse system in softcore mode and increased the maximum team count from 3 to 6; updated the main‑menu changelog to reflect the new limit.
Fixed lamps on player boats disappearing after moving away from where they were switched on.
Fixed lights beyond their culling distance flashing at full brightness before turning off.
Lights that were occlusion‑culled now correctly turn back on when reused or switched on, preventing dark areas after pool reuse.
Stair blocks in the Scrap King building skin now have corrected geometry and colliders, improving placement and traversal.
Additional block updates for the Scrap King skin fix placement and interaction issues.
Further block tweaks for Scrap King skin resolve lingering building quirks.
Inventory/crafting D‑pad toggle description clarified and inverted, reducing confusion when configuring controls.
Skin viewer no longer shows an erroneous cart button when opened from the Steam inventory.

2026-10-22.summary:
### Building & Construction
- Merged rotate and flip actions into a single pie‑menu slot, toggled with E/Q, preserving muscle memory and adjusting building tiers.
- Added mirrored stair skin prefabs and a bake tool, expanding the variety of usable building skins.

### Tools & Items
- Fixed a bug where the spray can became unusable after quickly looking away, requiring re‑equip, and removed a duplicate third‑person spray animation.

### Sailing
- Corrected the server collider for sails so only the appropriate (raised or lowered) collider is active after spawning.

### User Interface
- Fixed the quit button so it now works correctly.

### Softcore Mode Adjustments
- Disabled the deployable corpse system in softcore mode and increased the maximum team count from 3 to 6; updated the main‑menu changelog to reflect the new limit.

### Lighting
- Fixed lamps on player boats disappearing after moving away from where they were switched on.
- Fixed lights beyond their culling distance flashing at full brightness before turning off.

### Visual & Lighting
- Lights that were occlusion‑culled now correctly turn back on when reused or switched on, preventing dark areas after pool reuse.

### Gameplay & Building
- Stair blocks in the Scrap King building skin now have corrected geometry and colliders, improving placement and traversal.
- Additional block updates for the Scrap King skin fix placement and interaction issues.
- Further block tweaks for Scrap King skin resolve lingering building quirks.

### UI & Quality of Life
- Inventory/crafting D‑pad toggle description clarified and inverted, reducing confusion when configuring controls.
- Skin viewer no longer shows an erroneous cart button when opened from the Steam inventory.
